column1: tutorial_02/¿No me reconoces? Soy tu tío Chiringelio./Don't you recognize me? I'm your Uncle Chiringelio.
tutorial_03/Te voy a dar unas Chirisetas. ¡Pero no te las gastes todas en beberte unas birras!/I'm going to give you some Chirisetas/ but don't spend them all on beer!

column2: comprate al menos un par de mesas y sillas./Before you start your day/ buy at least a pair of tables and a chairs.

column3: hoy me he hecho yo cargo
column5: you'll need food. I've taken care of it today
column6: but you'll have to buy it tomorrow.

column1: tutorial_06/Ale! Que me hago viejo. ¡Abre la puerta y que comience el día!/Hey! I'm getting old. What are you waiting for? Open the door and let the day begin!.
